summary: The attempt-2 objection rested on the assumption that no rebuild had reached this branch, and git shows it had. HEAD a3d3860 is the merge commit with 2e089a1 (uat, bringing in SL-040) as a parent. `git merge-base --is-ancestor 2e089a1 HEAD` returns 0, no merge is in progress, and uat has not moved since 2e089a1. The slice record shows build-slice #2, code-review #2 and validate-slice #2 all passed at a3d3860, after the merge. Those are the conditions the objection named for approving instead, so there was nothing new to merge or resolve. I discharged O-025 by amending docs/design/SL-020-scanner.md's byte-accessor line with the fix's own text. I then rebuilt the current tree in Release and ran all of Core.Tests: 199/199 passed. That includes the link, hardlink, unreadable-folder, rollup and rollup-timing tests, and SL-040's LargestFiles tests.
